title: Fear
spec: Get out of the ring round the light.

say: Your goal is to wire its control board to make it flee the light on its right.
Objectives are what the level asks. Here, get out of the ring before the 10 s are out.
The window has two tabs: Run plays the level and the Editor builds the control board.
Click the Editor tab or the Editor button now.
The board is your swimmer's body. Click a cell, and the Wheel, in Tools, shows what goes there.
The nav bar opens the drawers: Tools, Parts, Files, Diagnostic, Navigator. At its foot: Hints, Settings, Chapters, and Run.
Now it is time to wire sensors and actuators!
If you are stuck, try clicking Hints.
